rejection_reason: See analysis/reviewer_fairness/temporal_order_audit.{json,md} and docs/reviewer_fairness_temporal_rules.md. The implicit assumption that request positions [50000,100000) of each raw source occur chronologically after the canonical [0,50000) test range is confirmed TRUE for only 3 of 7 families (twemcache, metacdn, cloudphysics -- where it disqualifies them under classification D, 'later same-family data', per the frozen temporal rule) and is demonstrably FALSE or unverifiable for the other 4 (brightkite, citibike: raw order is grouped by entity, not time, with near-total calendar-range overlap between segments; wiki2018, metakv: no verifiable time axis in the source at all). 0 of 7 families are eligible as constructed. Training was stopped during Stage 1 (dataset construction, before any model was fit) once this was discovered; no evict_value_v1_fair_v1.pkl was ever produced. This record is preserved as rejected history, not deleted, per this task's requirements.
superseded_by: evict_value_v1_fair_v2 (not yet designed/built -- see docs/reviewer_fairness_temporal_rules.md 'What would make each family eligible' for the concrete path)
frozen_at_commit: PRE-TRAINING (see git log at time of freeze)
purpose: Corrects the CRITICAL train/test overlap in models/evict_value_wulver_v1_best.pkl (see analysis/reviewer_fairness/evict_value_v1_overlap_audit.json). Training/validation data are drawn ONLY from data/processed_fair_v1/ (request positions [50000,100000) of the same 7 raw source datasets), never from data/processed/ (the canonical [0,50000) evaluation range).

training_data.non_overlap_verification: Each family's first 50,000 reparsed records were asserted equal to the canonical data/processed/{family}/trace.jsonl before extracting records[50000:100000) -- proves the extraction methodology exactly reproduces the canonical processing, so the disjoint slice is genuinely a continuation of the same source, not a different extraction.
training_data.records_per_family: ~50000 (49999 for metakv/metacdn -- raw source has 99999 lines)

candidate_dataset.horizon_note: Scoped to horizon=4 only (not a full {4,8,16} sweep) given this session's time budget. This is not a leakage-relevant choice -- horizon selects how many future steps the LOCAL replay-based label looks ahead within the training trace itself (data/processed_fair_v1, never data/processed) -- but it is a scope reduction relative to the original heavy_r1 build, predeclared before training, not selected by comparing to canonical-trace performance. horizon=4 reuses the ORIGINAL heavy_r1 ablation's own finding (validation MAE/RMSE/top-1/regret all degrade monotonically as horizon increases from 4) as a modeling prior, not as leaked test information -- that finding is about general model behavior under the label-construction mechanism, not about the specific canonical evaluation traces' request content.

model_selection.selection_metric: val_mean_regret (mean_regret_vs_oracle on the validation split only, never the internal test split, never the canonical traces)
model_selection.tie_breaking: lower val_mae, then lower val_rmse (exact logic of the existing, unmodified scripts/train_evict_value_wulver_v1.py, reused as-is -- the same selection methodology already used to select the contaminated heavy_r1 model, now applied to the disjoint corpus)
model_selection.search_space_note: Scoped to 1 horizon x 3 model families = 3 configurations (vs. original heavy_r1's up-to-9), given this session's time budget. Predeclared before any configuration was fit.
model_selection.staging_note: scripts/train_evict_value_wulver_v1.py hardcodes its selected-best output filename to 'evict_value_wulver_v1_best.pkl' inside --models-dir. To avoid ANY risk of overwriting the canonical models/evict_value_wulver_v1_best.pkl, this run points --models-dir at a separate staging directory (models/fair_v1_staging/); the winning artifact is copied to the final path below only after the run completes.

evaluation_protocol.traces: the ORIGINAL canonical data/processed/{family}/trace.jsonl (analysis/wulver_trace_manifest_full.csv) -- never data/processed_fair_v1/

amendment_policy: Any change to this protocol after viewing evaluation results on the canonical traces requires a new protocol_id (e.g. evict_value_v1_fair_v2) and an explicit, documented reason in docs/evict_value_v1_fair_training_protocol.md -- this file must never be edited in place after evaluation results are known.
